name: follower-rush
title: Follower Rush
description: An X-style follower notification that piles up — avatars stack in and the count explodes, then the row bends into an undulating wave of faces.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/social/follower-rush?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
